title: MOTO RUSH
one_line: Race a 3D superbike through traffic, upgrade five bikes and beat three new challenges every day.
how_to_play: Touch the left or right side of the screen to steer, hold NITRO to boost, and pass close to cars for near-miss bonuses.
description:
Moto Rush is a fast 3D bike game. Your superbike speeds up by itself, and you ride through busy traffic on a sunset coast, a neon city night, a desert road and an alpine pass. You only need to steer, brake and use your nitro.

The fun is in the close calls. Pass near a car without touching it and you earn bonus points and free nitro. Chain near misses together for a big combo, and boost to pop a wheelie for even more points. Hit a car and the run ends, but you get one second chance in every run.

Between rides, you can unlock five bikes, from the Rover 250 to the Phantom X hyperbike and the MotoRush RR race bike. Spend your coins on upgrades for the engine, nitro, tyres and brakes. Every day there are three new challenges and a Daily Run, the same road for everyone, with a streak to keep alive. It is made for anyone who wants quick, exciting rides that are easy to start and hard to put down.
controls: Steer: touch the left or right side of the screen, or use the left and right arrows or A and D.
Brake: hold BRAKE, or press the down arrow or S.
Nitro: hold NITRO, or press Space, Shift, the up arrow or W.
tips: Pass close to cars without touching them. You get bonus points and free nitro.
Save your second chance for a good run, because you only get one each time.
Do the Daily Run every day to keep your streak going.
